facts.claim: In an online survey of 1,000 U.S. adults commissioned by Greetwell, a travel concierge company, in August 2026, 55% of the 485 who had used AI for travel got at least one bad recommendation, and 1 in 6 (16%) were recommended a place, tour or activity that wasn't real.

sources.title: Stacker: Survey: AI hallucinated travel destinations for 1 in 6 users

facts.note: Commissioned by a company that sells travel help, so say who ran it whenever we quote it. Find Greetwell's own release.
